title: Cambridge_data_resting
description: Resting-state functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) recordings from the Cambridge_data_resting dataset, originally deposited on OpenNeuro (ds007719) by Emilia Butters and mirrored on NEMAR. The dataset is organized according to BIDS and contains 66 files (about 8.62 GB) of continuous fNIRS data in SNIRF format, with accompanying JSON and TSV sidecar files describing channels, optodes, and events. Detailed information on participants, acquisition hardware, and experimental protocol is not provided in the available documentation.
